sn22.83:2.1: Puṇṇa son of Mantāṇī was most famous for his conversation with Sāriputta in [mn24](), on the strength of which he was said to be the best Dhamma speaker ([an1.196]()). His verse is at [thag1.4:1.7]().
sn22.83:2.3: Take care of the double nested quotes.
sn22.83:4.3: Note here the extreme equality in terms of address: even a newly ordained monk speaks like this to their teacher.
